name: Saraswati Saree Depot Limited
summary: Saraswati Saree Depot Limited, established in 1966 and based in Kolhapur, India, distributes traditional and ethnic women's clothing at wholesale. It sells sarees, kurtis, dress materials, blouse pieces, lehengas and related accessories. Customers are served online and through stores in Kolhapur and Ulhasnagar.
